No Bureaucracy Can Stop Love.
Our A/5 Visa Journey with Deep Gratitude to Lior

Dear Lior,

Sometimes in life, in order to reach happiness, you have to go through a long and complicated bureaucratic journey. One day ago, we finally received our long-awaited 1 year A/5 visa. We would like to share our deepest and most heartfelt gratitude to Lior Beres.

Lior, without the incredible community and association you established for mixed couples (AIC in Israel), we probably would not have even known about the possibility of a Utah marriage. The information, tools, and support you provided  were a true turning point for us. In moments when the journey seemed exhausting and impossible, you were there to guide us, support us, and give us strength. Without your help, we might have given up along the way.

Your dedication, your kindness, and the way you fight for people like us mean more than words can express. You didn’t just help us with the process, you gave us hope, strength, and belief when we needed it most.

The process is very difficult, and along the way you experience many ups and downs. But with support like yours and AIC, you find the strength within yourself to stand up again and keep fighting. We know this is only the beginning of our bureaucratic journey, but you have given us the hope and strength to believe that one day we will reach the finish line in this marathon.

Today we know that love should not be stopped by bureaucracy. With the right people by your side, you can rise above any obstacle there are no limits.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Best regards,

Eliran and Paulina 

❤️💙🇵🇱🇮🇱

Lior Beres
